chapter.title: GENERAL PROVISIONS AS TO INQUIRIES AND TRIALS

heading: Right of person against whom proceedings are instituted to be defended.
text: Any person accused of an offence before a Criminal Court, or against whom proceedings are instituted under this Code, may of right be defended by a pleader of his choice.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
